title: 第5章 一人怼全宗第6章 上天派来救赎她的神明
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 黎阳看着洛云卿不停拭泪的动作，心都疼死了，“云卿师妹都哭了，你还想怎么样？你的心是石头做的吗？”
林筱直接开骂，“她污蔑人她还有理了？跟谁不会哭一样，诗芷晴也哭了，头还磕破了呢，你怎么不关心她？”
“我的心要是石头做的，那你的心是什么做的？天外玄铁吗？”
黎阳被林筱怼的一噎，差点回一句：诗芷晴能和他的云卿师妹比吗？
但幸好理智尚存，他没有说出口。
大长老这时出来打圆场了，“好了，既然是一场误会，那就……”
这么散了吧。
话没说完，林筱就预感他要说什么，直接插嘴道：“大长老，洛云卿她竟然敢陷害自家师姐，这番行径实在是太过卑鄙，弟子请求，把洛云卿逐出宗门！”
本来看原着，林筱还觉得大长老在天衍宗众长老中算公平的，如今一看，公平屁啊！
诗芷晴偷丹药，大长老说诗芷晴品行不端要把她逐出宗门，现在轮到洛云卿了，就通通不追究了，就算了，这件事就这么过去吧，凭什么？
大长老想让这件事就这么过去，她偏不！
反正都这样了，她不介意让矛盾更大一点。
来啊，互相伤害啊。
如林筱所想的，她这话一出，天衍宗众弟子瞬间不干了。
“不行！
不能把云卿师妹逐出宗门！”
“云卿师妹固然有错，但错不大，我看这事就这么过去好了。”
“对啊，我看云卿师妹已经意识到自己的错了，放过她吧。”
还有人性子急，直接对林筱开骂。
“大师姐你什么意思，云卿师妹哪得罪你了，你就要把她逐出宗门？”
“逐出宗门这惩罚太狠了吧，真看不出来大师姐你是如此心狠的人。”
对这群双标弟子的智障言论，林筱回头毫不客气回怼：“洛云卿诬陷诗芷晴的错小，那刚才诗芷晴跪在地上哭着为自己辩解时，你们怎么不说她错小了？”
“对，就你们几个，你们那个时候喊把诗芷晴逐出宗门喊的不是挺起劲的吗，怎么一换洛云卿就不行了。”
“不知道的还以为洛云卿是你们妈呢，护她护的那么紧。”
她又转向刚刚骂她心狠的几个弟子，“还有你们，我把洛云卿逐出宗门就心狠，那看诗芷晴跪地磕头都不为所动的你们是不是一个个都改修魔道了。”
“自己做不到公平还用道德指责别人，不会说话就闭嘴，不说话没人拿你当哑巴。”
“我就站在这儿，今天谁再替洛云卿说一句话，都算洛云卿同伙，全逐出宗门去！”
妈的，跟她吵架玩道德绑架，她怼不死他们！
林筱说完话，全场鸦雀无声。
content_en:
"You!"
Li Yang felt his heart aching when he saw Luo Yunqing wiping away her tears, "Junior sister Yunqing is crying, what else do you want? Is your heart made of stone?"
Lin Xiao scolded directly, "How can she be justified in slandering others? Just like who can't cry, Shi Zhiqing also cried and broke her head. Why don't you care about her?"
"If my heart is made of stone, what is your heart made of? Is it black iron?"
Li Yang was choked by Lin Xiao and almost replied: Can Shi Zhiqing compare with his junior sister Yunqing?
But luckily he still had sense and didn't say anything.
The Great Elder came out to smooth things over at this time, "Okay, since it's a misunderstanding, then..."
Let’s break up like this.
Before he finished speaking, Lin Xiao had a premonition of what he was going to say and directly interrupted: "Elder, Luo Yunqing dared to frame her senior sister. This behavior is really despicable. Disciple requests that Luo Yunqing be expelled from the sect!"
Originally reading the original work, Lin Xiao thought that the Great Elder was fair among the elders of the Tianyan Sect, but now that he looked at it, he was far from fair!
Shi Zhiqing stole the elixir. The elder said that Shi Zhiqing had bad conduct and wanted to expel her from the sect. Now it is Luo Yunqing's turn, so he will not pursue it at all. Forget it, let this matter go away like this. Why?
The great elder wanted this matter to go away, but she didn't want to!
That's it anyway, she doesn't mind making the conflict a little bigger.
Come on, let's hurt each other.
As Lin Xiao thought, as soon as she said these words, all the disciples of Tianyan Sect quit immediately.
"No!
Junior Sister Yunqing cannot be expelled from the sect! "
"Junior Sister Yunqing is certainly at fault, but it's not a big mistake. I think it's best to let this matter go as it is."
"Yes, I think Junior Sister Yunqing has realized her mistake. Let her go."
Some people were impatient and scolded Lin Xiao directly.
"Senior Sister, what do you mean? Junior Sister Yunqing has offended you, why are you expelling her from the sect?"
"The punishment of being expelled from the sect is too harsh. I really don't understand that you are such a cruel person, Senior Sister."
Lin Xiao turned around and responded unceremoniously to the retarded remarks of this group of double-standard disciples: "Luo Yunqing was at fault for falsely accusing Shi Zhiqing. Then when Shi Zhiqing was kneeling on the ground crying and defending herself, why didn't you say she was at fault?"
"Yes, it's just you. Aren't you very energetic in calling for Shi Zhiqing to be expelled from the sect? How come it won't work once Luo Yunqing is replaced?"
"For those who don't know, they think Luo Yunqing is your mother. He protects her so closely."
She turned to the disciples who had just scolded her for being cruel, "And you, I was cruel when I expelled Luo Yunqing from the sect. Then you who were unmoved even when Shi Zhiqing knelt down and kowtowed, have you all switched to the devil's path?"
"If you can't be fair, you still use morality to accuse others. If you can't speak, just shut up. If you don't speak, no one will treat you as a mute."
"I'm just standing here. Anyone who says a word for Luo Yunqing today will be considered Luo Yunqing's accomplice and will be expelled from the sect!"
Damn it, if you quarrel with her and play moral kidnapping, she can't beat them to death!
After Lin Xiao finished speaking, the entire audience was silent.
title_en: Chapter 5: One person against the whole sect Chapter 6: The god sent by heaven to redeem her
